definition: GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) (BBG) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 70 mg. faq.question: How is GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each lot of GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) is analysed by HPLC for purity and by mass spectrometry for identity. The lot-specific certificate of analysis reports the measured purity, retention time, molecular mass and appearance. Catalogue purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC).

faq.question: How should GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) be stored?
faq.answer: Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. After reconstitution, keep the solution at 2-8 °C and use it within the period stated in the lot certificate of analysis. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. This product is for laboratory research use only.
